_about: BUG-013 round 2 (Claude, 2026-10-09): block labels that contradict the eCFR section heading, and two section-level quotes that pulled in an unrelated SARS-CoV-2 paragraph. Keys are block positions in the templates AFTER decisions_2026-10-09.json; 'was' guards against a stale file.

001_accreditation_body_notification.json.label: Condition: Facility administration
001_accreditation_body_notification.json.reason: 493.1100 is 'Condition: Facility administration' (General laboratory systems is 493.1230). Quoting the introductory text only; the section's (a) is the SARS-CoV-2 reporting rule, unrelated to this policy.

004_unsuccessful_pt_response.json#2.reason: 493.1299 is postanalytic systems quality assessment, not 'Corrective actions' (493.1282).
